name: SEO Sprint Project Plan
description: Standard 6-month SEO engagement with phased sprints

deliverables.name: Access Collection
deliverables.description: Collect GA4, GSC, CMS access from client

deliverables.name: Kickoff Strategy Call
deliverables.description: Initial strategy discussion with client - review goals, timeline, expectations

deliverables.name: Project Timeline Document
deliverables.description: Create project timeline and expectations document for client

deliverables.name: Site Crawl
deliverables.description: Run comprehensive site crawl (Screaming Frog or similar)

deliverables.name: Technical Audit
deliverables.description: Identify technical SEO issues: indexing, site speed, mobile, structured data

deliverables.name: Content Inventory
deliverables.description: Categorize all pages by type, quality, and traffic performance

deliverables.name: Backlink Analysis
deliverables.description: Analyze backlink profile using Ahrefs - identify gaps and opportunities

deliverables.name: Competitor Analysis
deliverables.description: Benchmark against top 3 competitors - DR, traffic, content gaps

deliverables.name: Website Quality Audit Report
deliverables.description: Compile findings into comprehensive WQA report with action items

deliverables.name: WQA Presentation
deliverables.description: Present WQA findings to client and align on priorities

deliverables.name: Technical Fixes Implementation
deliverables.description: Implement priority technical fixes from audit

deliverables.name: Keyword Research
deliverables.description: Research target keywords based on WQA findings and business goals

deliverables.name: Content Brief #1
deliverables.description: Create detailed content brief for first article

deliverables.name: Content Brief #2
deliverables.description: Create detailed content brief for second article

deliverables.name: Article Draft #1
deliverables.description: Write first article based on brief

deliverables.name: Article Draft #2
deliverables.description: Write second article based on brief

deliverables.name: Client Review
deliverables.description: Client reviews and approves content

deliverables.name: Content Publishing
deliverables.description: Publish approved content with on-page optimization

deliverables.name: Internal Linking Update
deliverables.description: Update internal links to support new content

deliverables.name: Link Prospect Research
deliverables.description: Identify 50+ link prospects in client's niche

deliverables.name: Outreach Email Templates
deliverables.description: Create personalized outreach templates

deliverables.name: Outreach Campaign Launch
deliverables.description: Begin outreach to link prospects

deliverables.name: Follow-up Outreach
deliverables.description: Follow up with non-responders

deliverables.name: Link Placement Tracking
deliverables.description: Track secured links and update backlink inventory

deliverables.name: Link Building Report
deliverables.description: Monthly link building progress report

deliverables.name: Data Pull
deliverables.description: Pull GA4, GSC, Ahrefs data for reporting period

deliverables.name: Performance Report
deliverables.description: Compile monthly performance report with KPI tracking

deliverables.name: Strategy Review Call
deliverables.description: Monthly call to review performance and adjust strategy

deliverables.name: Next Month Planning
deliverables.description: Plan priorities for upcoming month
